normative_extracts.quote: Conflict-free Replicated Data Types guarantee that any two replicas that have received the same set of updates converge deterministically to identical state without central coordination.
IndexedDB is a transactional, asynchronous key-value and object store persisted locally in the browser for offline-capable applications.

browser_support.notes: Browser storage primitives (IndexedDB, OPFS) are widely supported; CRDT sync engines (Yjs, Automerge) live in userland libraries.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Writes mutations locally first at 0ms network wait, encoding operations with causal/Lamport clocks so offline peers merge deterministically upon reconnection.

production_failures.symptom: IndexedDB grows to hundreds of megabytes for a tiny 200-line collaborative document
production_failures.root_cause: CRDT retained every historical character insertion and tombstone deletion forever without periodic snapshot compaction.
production_failures.mitigation: Run periodic state-vector compaction/garbage collection once all active replicas acknowledge a causal checkpoint.

production_failures.symptom: Concurrent offline edits overwrite each other silently (Last-Write-Wins data loss)
production_failures.root_cause: Sync engine used raw wall-clock Date.now() LWW registers on whole-document blobs instead of field/character-level CRDTs.
production_failures.mitigation: Use Hybrid Logical Clocks (HLC) for field-level LWW-Element-Sets or sequence CRDTs (RGA/YATA) for rich text.
